title: The Drop of the Free Port Again
author: Lena Vasquez
blurb: Juniper Galloway, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the summit convenes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
